criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, editable source reopen, two separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, real transformed dimensions, contact and global exposure.

All eight separate final512px views personally inspected; required diagnostic features readable and globally exposed. Retain soft oval flapped trunk, large frontal appendages and single median tail. Reject generated globular/extra eyes: actual model uses only two low kidney-shaped lobes at ventrolateral appendage bases. Correct axial ornament to eleven rows of four, not two columns. Preserve soft legs and ventral mouth below rounded anterior lobe.

Eleven paired lateral flaps form an oval envelope, largest fourth/fifth; eleven axial rows of four low tubercles. Two flexible frontal appendages with elongate inward spines, small rounded anterior lobe and paired low kidney-shaped ventrolateral eyes beneath appendage bases. One long unsegmented median posterior tail, nearly trunk length; eleven pairs of short soft lobopods beneath flaps, paired rostral spines around ventral anterior mouth. Genus/species level Lower Cambrian soft-bodied reconstruction, not fossil cast.2018 eyes and tail reinterpretation used. Body thickness, soft leg pose, pigment and spine spacing are artistic; no hard arthrodized plates or invented internal brain.
